name: Kumano Hongū Taisha
heritage: Important Cultural Property of Japan; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
type: Shinto shrine; Kumano shrine; taisha; massha; Shikinai Ronsha; Kokuhei-sha; Shikinai Supershrine
text: Kumano Hongū Taisha (熊野本宮大社) is a Shinto shrine in Tanabe in Wakayama, Japan. It is included as part of the Kumano Sanzan in the World Heritage Site "Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range". The main deities enshrined are Kumano Sansho Gongen (熊野三所権現): Ketsumimiko (家津美御子), Hayatama (速玉) and Fusubi (牟須美).

credit.text: Tim Notari from Tanabe-Shi Wakayama-Ken, Japan
